proof_body:
by
  intro R L A _ _ _ _ _
  letI : LieRing A := LieRing.ofAssociativeRing
  letI : LieAlgebra R A := LieAlgebra.ofAssociativeAlgebra
  intro f
  refine ⟨UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift R f, fun x => UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift_ι_apply R f x, ?_⟩
  intro g hg
  apply (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift_unique R f g).mp
  ext x
  exact hg x
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) (L : Type*) (A : Type*) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [Ring A] [Algebra R A], (letI : LieRing A := LieRing.ofAssociativeRing; letI : LieAlgebra R A := LieAlgebra.ofAssociativeAlgebra; ∀ f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ A, ∃! g : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L →ₐ[R] A, ∀ x : L, g (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R x) = f x)
